26# GCU400 flat grid-stride rewrite of the KernelGen seed (fixed BLOCK=1024, 

27# grid=cdiv(n, 1024)): the seed exceeds the grid.x=65535 hardware limit at 

28# n >= 64Mi elements, so the core-bench cases at 2^29 elements die with 

29# triton OutOfResources (repro: grid_0=524288, 2026-11-17, hardtanh and 

30# hardtanh_out both FAILED with no numbers). The flat form below (grid = 

31# min(cdiv(n, BLOCK), 48) grid-striding over tiles, EVEN mask elision, 

32# numel-based BLOCK/num_warps ladder) reuses the ladder measured for the 

33# in-place hardtanh_ retune (2026-11-17) verbatim: the out-of-place op has 

34# the same 1R1W clamp traffic (read n, write n, native-dtype clamp body), 

35# and that probe found 16-bit BODY=3 at DRAM floor (667.5us @2^29 = 

36# 1.015x native, copy floor 668-675us) and fp32 flat on the floor too 

37# (1334us @2^29 = native parity), so only the tiny band differs from 

38# native (3.2us vs 4.6-4.7us launch floor). 

39# 

40# Body variants (all bit-identical to the seed's 

41# min/max + explicit-NaN-restore math on every value the aten op can 

42# produce for float inputs; NaN propagates in 1 and 3 naturally, restored 

43# in 2): 

44# BODY=1 where-clamp in the aten promote-to-f32 compare domain 

45# (hardsigmoid precedent: -11% vs min/max+NaN-restore on 16-bit 

46# mid/large bands). 

47# BODY=2 the seed math itself: tl.minimum/tl.maximum + where(x != x, x, y). 

48# BODY=3 where-clamp with the scalars rounded once into the tensor's own 

49# dtype (clamp_max BODY=3 precedent). Stored results stay 

50# bit-identical to BODY=1 for every float input: rounding is 

51# monotone, so a boundary value that flips the compare rounds to 

52# the same stored element either way; NaN passes both forms. 

53# Skips the f32 round-trip cvt chain on 16-bit streams; never 

54# used for non-float dtypes (their seed math compares in f32). 

55# The kernel is a bare @triton.jit (no @libentry wrapper, dropped 2026-11-22 

56# together with the "one num_warps per BLOCK" bookkeeping it required): at the 

57# 4096-element launch floor the wrapper cost ~3.5% (0.00402 -> 0.00388ms, same 

58# process A/B on A084P50610001) while the mid/large bands are GPU-bound and 

59# unaffected. Triton's own cache key includes num_warps, so BODY stays the only 

60# extra discriminator. 

61# 

62# WIDE arm: for numel past the int32-safe offset domain the flat offsets 

63# are computed in int64 (randn_like WIDE-arm precedent, 2026-11-16); this 

64# keeps the flat-grid int32-wrap hazard closed without a second kernel and 

65# with no upper size limit, where the seed would crash on the grid bound 

66# anyway. 

67NUM_SIPS = 24 

68_FLAT_GRID_CAP = NUM_SIPS * 2 

69# Max flat offset touched by the masked tail tile is ~N + BLOCK; keep the 

70# int32 lane for N <= 2^31 - 2^17 (BLOCK <= 131072). 

71_INT32_SAFE_LIMIT = (1 << 31) - (1 << 17) 

72 

73_FLAT_DTYPES = (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16, torch.float32)

76@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["N", "min_val", "max_val"]) 

77def _hardtanh_flat_kernel( 

78 X, 

79 Y, 

80 N, 

81 min_val, 

82 max_val, 

83 BODY: tl.constexpr, 

84 BLOCK: tl.constexpr, 

85 EVEN: tl.constexpr, 

86 WIDE: tl.constexpr, 

87): 

88 pid = tl.program_id(0) 

89 num_ctas = tl.num_programs(0) 

90 num_tiles = tl.cdiv(N, BLOCK) 

91 for tile in range(pid, num_tiles, num_ctas): 

92 if WIDE: 

93 offs = tile.to(tl.int64) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

94 else: 

95 offs = tile * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK) 

96 if EVEN: 

97 x = tl.load(X + offs) 

98 else: 

99 mask = offs < N 

100 x = tl.load(X + offs, mask=mask) 

101 if BODY == 1: 

102 y = tl.where(x < min_val, min_val, tl.where(x > max_val, max_val, x)) 

103 elif BODY == 2: 

104 y = tl.minimum(tl.maximum(x, min_val), max_val) 

105 y = tl.where(x != x, x, y) 

106 else: 

107 mn = min_val.to(X.dtype.element_ty) 

108 mx = max_val.to(X.dtype.element_ty) 

109 y = tl.where(x < mn, mn, tl.where(x > mx, mx, x)) 

110 if EVEN: 

111 tl.store(Y + offs, y) 

112 else: 

113 tl.store(Y + offs, y, mask=mask)

116def _hardtanh_flat_config(numel, dtype): 

117 # (BLOCK, num_warps, BODY, grid_cap) per-band ladder. 

118 # 

119 # Body choice (2026-11-17 probe, still current): 16-bit uses BODY=3 

120 # (native-domain where-clamp), which beats the f32-compare BODY=1 by -11% 

121 # at 2^24 and -5% at 2^29; BODY=2 (seed min/max math) measured -8..-20% on 

122 # 16-bit and is only reached on the degenerate min>max domain. fp32 uses 

123 # BODY=1, every body/config there sits on the DRAM floor. 

124 # 

125 # Tile / CTA re-measured on 2026-11-21 with a same-process real-op A/B 

126 # harness (interleaved rounds, min-of-5 rounds, real aten hardtanh.out 

127 # baseline) on the 4.0 board A084P50610002: the former 8192/nw2@24CTA tile 

128 # paid a heavy stride cost in the big bands, so 16-bit now uses 

129 # 2^16 < numel <= 2^24 : 32768/nw2@48 (2^24 0.0813 vs 0.0854ms) 

130 # numel > 2^24 : 65536/nw4@48 (2^25 0.0508 vs 0.1345ms, 

131 # 2^29 0.7112 vs 2.0204ms, 1.085x vs 

132 # 0.382x of the native kernel) 

133 # The 16-bit ladder keeps BODY=3 in both bands. 

134 # fp32 above 2^21: 65536/nw8 replaces the 32768/nw2 mid tile (+0.9% at 

135 # 2^22, +0.4% at 2^24, +0.5% at 2^25, parity at 2^29) and now matches 

136 # the big band, so one config covers everything above 2^21. 

137 # <=2^21 stays untouched for both widths: the narrow 16384/nw2 (fp32) 

138 # and 8192/nw2 (16-bit) tiles are the measured winners there (a 65536 

139 # tile costs -5.2% at 2^18 in fp32). 

140 # Tiny band is launch-floor flat (3.2us vs native 4.6-4.7us) and keeps the 

141 # 2048 cap that beat a single 4096-wide CTA by 5-6% at numel=4096. 

142 # 

143 # 16-bit mid band folded into the big-band 65536/nw4@48 tile on 2026-11-22 

144 # (same-process interleaved A/B, 4 rounds x min-of-3, board A084P50610001, 

145 # numel=2^24): 65536 0.02796-0.02805ms vs 32768 0.02940-0.02947ms, i.e. 

146 # -5.0% and a stable 1.32x of the native kernel where 32768 gave 1.26x. 

147 # 131072 measured the same (0.02798), so the smaller tile is kept for its 

148 # cheaper tail. Only the 2^24 band moves; <=2^16 and >2^24 are unchanged. 

149 if dtype.is_floating_point and dtype.itemsize <= 2: 

150 if numel <= 4096: 

151 return min(max(triton.next_power_of_2(numel), 256), 2048), 2, 3, 48 

152 if numel <= 65536: 

153 return 2048, 2, 3, 48 

154 return 65536, 4, 3, 48 

155 if numel <= 4096: 

156 return min(max(triton.next_power_of_2(numel), 256), 2048), 2, 1, 48 

157 if numel <= 65536: 

158 return 2048, 2, 1, 48 

159 if numel <= (1 << 21): 

160 return 16384, 2, 1, 48 

161 return 65536, 8, 1, 48

164# Host-level flake guard: on this shared multi-tenant host the extern 

165# toolchain (gcu_compiler_llvm_ir_converter.sh children) intermittently 

166# segfaults during a fresh compile under fork-storm load; the same launch 

167# then succeeds on retry (failed compiles are not cached). Only 

168# signature-matched toolchain flakes are retried; deterministic errors 

169# raise (clamp_max_ / hardsigmoid_ precedents). 

170_TOOLCHAIN_FLAKE_MARKERS = ( 

171 "Segmentation fault", 

172 "converterResult", 

173 "serializing the module", 

174 "core dumped", 

175) 

176

178def _launch_flat(X, Y, numel, min_val, max_val, block, num_warps, body, grid_cap): 

179 if min_val > max_val: 

180 # Degenerate domain (min > max): aten hardtanh returns max_val 

181 # everywhere (min(max(x, min_val), max_val) composition), while 

182 # the where-clamp bodies would return min_val there. The 

183 # seed-math BODY=2 arm is aten-exact on this domain; it is never 

184 # selected on the hot path (valid min <= max). 

185 body = 2 

186 grid = (min(triton.cdiv(numel, block), grid_cap),) 

187 wide = numel > _INT32_SAFE_LIMIT 

188 for attempt in range(3): 

189 try: 

190 with torch_device_fn.device(X.device): 

191 _hardtanh_flat_kernel[grid]( 

192 X, 

193 Y, 

194 numel, 

195 min_val, 

196 max_val, 

197 BODY=body, 

198 BLOCK=block, 

199 EVEN=(numel % block == 0), 

200 WIDE=wide, 

201 num_warps=num_warps, 

202 ) 

203 return 

204 except Exception as exc: 

205 if attempt < 2 and any(m in str(exc) for m in _TOOLCHAIN_FLAKE_MARKERS): 

206 logger.debug( 

207 "hardtanh flat kernel toolchain flake on attempt %d, retrying", 

208 attempt, 

209 ) 

210 continue 

211 raise

214def hardtanh(A, min_val=-1.0, max_val=1.0): 

215 if not isinstance(A, torch.Tensor): 

216 raise TypeError("hardtanh(): expected a Tensor") 

217 if A.dtype not in _FLAT_DTYPES: 

218 from flag_gems.ops.hardtanh import hardtanh as _public 

219 

220 return _public(A, min_val, max_val) 

221 

222 inp = A.contiguous() 

223 n_total = inp.numel() 

224 if n_total == 0: 

225 return torch.empty_like(inp) 

226 out = torch.empty_like(inp) 

227 

228 block, num_warps, body, grid_cap = _hardtanh_flat_config(n_total, inp.dtype) 

229 _launch_flat( 

230 inp, 

231 out, 

232 n_total, 

233 float(min_val), 

234 float(max_val), 

235 block, 

236 num_warps, 

237 body, 

238 grid_cap, 

239 ) 

240 return out

243def hardtanh_out(A, min_val=-1.0, max_val=1.0, *, out=None): 

244 logger.debug("GEMS_ENFLAME HARDTANH_OUT") 

245 if out is None: 

246 return hardtanh(A, min_val, max_val) 

247 if not isinstance(A, torch.Tensor) or not isinstance(out, torch.Tensor): 

248 raise TypeError("hardtanh_out(): expected Tensors") 

249 assert A.numel() == out.numel() 

250 if A.dtype not in _FLAT_DTYPES or out.dtype != A.dtype: 

251 from flag_gems.ops.hardtanh import hardtanh_out as _public 

252 

253 return _public(A, min_val, max_val, out=out) 

254 

255 inp = A.contiguous() 

256 n_total = out.numel() 

257 if n_total == 0: 

258 return out 

259 

260 block, num_warps, body, grid_cap = _hardtanh_flat_config(n_total, inp.dtype) 

261 if not out.is_contiguous(): 

262 # Strided out cannot take flat stores; land the result in a fresh 

263 # contiguous buffer and copy back through out's strides 

264 # (hardswish_out strided-out precedent). 

265 tmp = torch.empty_like(inp) 

266 _launch_flat( 

267 inp, 

268 tmp, 

269 n_total, 

270 float(min_val), 

271 float(max_val), 

272 block, 

273 num_warps, 

274 body, 

275 grid_cap, 

276 ) 

277 out.copy_(tmp) 

278 return out
